drums.tags: Percussion ensemble piece featuring a single wooden block or high-pitched wood percussion instrument. The performance consists of a steady, unadorned quarter-note pulse at 120 BPM. The timbre is dry with a short decay and minimal room resonance. The rhythm is strictly metronomic with no dynamic variation or syncopation. The recording captures a single monophonic source with a clean, transparent signal chain.

bass.tags: Funk, disco-influenced instrumental. A clean, DI-style electric guitar plays a syncopated 16th-note scratch rhythm with frequent palm muting and percussive rakes. A slap bass guitar follows the guitar rhythm with aggressive thumb pops and finger plucks. The drum kit features a tight, high-tuned snare and a dry kick drum. Handclaps are layered on the backbeat. The tempo is 115 BPM in the key of E minor. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interlocking rhythmic relationship between the bass and the muted guitar strums.

[slap bass enters with syncopated pops]

[tight snare and dry kick drum enter]
[handclaps on beats 2 and 4]
[interlocking slap bass and muted guitar riffs]
